P1.evidence: The application was acknowledged but not read back — 'I already saw your application as well, but I just want to have an actual conversation with you' — so nothing specific was reflected to make him feel seen. No four-part frame; the opening was a fit frame only. Agreement obtained ('okay? Okay. Yeah, no problem.'). Open question asked. The rep also got a pen and paper in hand before starting, which is good practice not covered by the checks.

P2.evidence: The only full P2a in this batch to date: weight, height and age all asked and answered (144-147 lb, 5'6-5'7, 33). P2b was asked in the exact scripted shape: 'Does that mean that you're always like more so in a sedentary position or do you also move around a lot at work?' Training reality and diet were both probed properly. But health conditions were never asked — kyphosis was volunteered — and sleep was never asked, which is a significant omission for a man who has just moved from night shifts to days and named that transition as his fatigue source.

P3.evidence: The strongest goals work in the batch. 'what does worst shape for you mean? Is it like you look in the mirror and you're just not happy?' produced a performance answer rather than an aesthetic one. The bridge ran twice: 'Why are we then here now? Why not just wait for another few months?' and 'why is it important for you to get in shape now again and actually stay that way too?' The reflect-back landed: 'it sounds like for you, it's more of like an actual reason, like I need to do something with this. Rather than it's a nice to have. Is that correct?' The one clear miss is P3f — he mentioned a wife, nieces, a nephew, a dog and a mother-in-law, and was never asked who else this impacts.

P4.evidence: P4d ran in almost scripted form: 'What's sort of the missing thing for you that you feel like that is what I need to get fixed with the help from Trevor in order to actually get it to be a habit instead of something you just do and then fall off?' and he named the gap himself — needing someone who knows more at his side to push him. But past attempts were only ever volunteered, and P4c was never asked despite roughly a decade of drift. He also claimed 'mentality has never been an issue for me. It's just been the habit' and the rep did not test that at all.

P5.evidence: The best consequence work in the batch, built on material the prospect supplied. 'Six months, a year from now, and you're still in the same place... How do you think that life would look like?' then the rep took the colleague image and made it the future: 'looking at that colleague of yours, it is literally like this. Do you think that if you don't like actually make the needed changes that you are going to slowly step towards having something like that?' He answered 'I think so. Yeah. I don't see why not.' Willingness to settle was then asserted rather than asked, and 'why not' and the line in the sand were never run.

P6.evidence: P6b ran cleanly and was then sharpened when the prospect answered too loosely: 'Would there be any reason that you're not going to get to the point where you're going to get rid of the hunching... Is there anything that would stop you from getting there?' followed by 'What I mainly mean by that question is nothing internally. I would say like, oh, well, I don't have the time.' A clear yes was in hand before the price was named.

P11.evidence: Best Phase 11 in the batch. First instalment processed live with the receipt number confirmed on both sides. Trevor onboarding booked for Wednesday 10.15am with the invite accepted live and 'It says scheduled' confirmed. Skool account created on the call. Onboarding form sent to WhatsApp and confirmed received. Only P11c falls short — the agreement email arrived and the prospect said 'let's get it done right now', but the rep never came back to confirm the signature before the call ended.

objection_plays.detail: Isolation ran: 'outside of the investment part, right? Do you feel like, yes, I want to do this. I want to get started.' Capacity was asked openly — 'What do you feel like would be possible for you?' — and answered with $1,000 monthly, which matches the offer exactly. A plan was structured and adjusted. None of the six financial-picture moves ran: no cash on hand, no monthly leftover after bills, no credit cards, no available credit, no used versus available, no investments. The play was short because it did not need to be long, but it was not the scripted play.

notes: The best-run call in the batch on process — Phases 3, 6 and 11 all executed, and the consequence frame used the prospect's own kyphotic colleague as the image of his future, which is exactly the intent of Phase 5. Two corrections. First, sleep was never asked of a man who had just come off five 12-hour night shifts a week and named that as his fatigue source. Second, the instalment quote was confusing enough that the prospect had to correct the arithmetic himself twice before the $7,200 six-payment total was explained.
